text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, mild anemia with low MCHC, and metabolic acidosis (low CO₂). There is mild hyperbilirubinemia, elevated ferritin and CRP, and a slightly prolonged INR. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and impaired oxygenation. Close clinical monitoring and further evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., infection, bone marrow suppression, hypoxic respiratory failure) are recommended.
